descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明
重置节点后，节点的系统和软件将恢复初始状态。如无特殊需要（如故障修复等），请勿重置处于运行中状态的节点，以免作业无法正常运行。
descriptions.en:
## Description

Resetting a node restores its operating system and software to their initial states. To ensure that your jobs run properly, do not reset a node that is in the \`running\` state unless it is for a special purpose, such as crash recovery.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc reset-nodes --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --instance Id=i-bp13p7vlcb1uihfv0000 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
